0022600120.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves (3-0, on a three-game winning streak and 6th in the West) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1, 9th in the East and 3rd in the Central, one game back). Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury that required surgery. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 10, 2026 in Cleveland, where the Timberwolves lost 146-134.
